title: 财阀千金奢华生日宴写真
promptCh:
请基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，生成一张 2×2 四宫格拼贴写真，主题为「千金财阀生日宴请写真」。

【人物一致性】
请严格保留人物真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础和整体气质。四张小图里都必须清楚看起来是同一个人，不要变成陌生人，不要欧美化，不要网红化，不要过度磨皮，不要出现 AI 假脸。

【整体风格定位】
整体风格不是普通生日写真，而是“韩国财阀千金 / 豪门名媛 / old money / 私人生日宴 / 红毯抓拍感高奢写真”。人物气质必须高冷美艳、矜贵疏离、贵气张扬，带有明显的上位者气场和被众人簇拥的中心感。她不是甜美可爱型寿星，而是像豪门千金在私人晚宴现场被媒体和宾客围拍到的主角。

【画面形式】
生成一张 2×2 四宫格拼图。每一格都是独立的竖构图，单张比例为 3:4。最终只呈现 4 张小图，但请从下方提供的 7 个候选镜头中选择 4 个进行组合。四张图必须像同一场豪门生日晚宴里的不同镜头切片，而不是同一姿势的重复变体。每张图都要在景别、机位、表情、动作、视线方向、身体朝向和互动方式上明显不同。

【统一性要求】
四张小图必须严格保持为同一个宴会场地、同一套礼服、同一套妆发、同一套头饰、同一套珠宝配饰。不要四张图分别换场景，也不要分别换衣服。整组图要像同一晚、同一场财阀千金生日宴中，被连续拍下的 4 个不同高光瞬间。

【拍摄感觉】
整体强调“闪光灯抓拍感”和“红毯式宴会现场拍摄感”。画面要有明显的直闪 / 机顶闪光灯质感，带来偏硬朗的高光、清晰的皮肤反光、局部过曝高光、强烈的镜头存在感和现场纪实抓拍氛围。不是柔雾感纯棚拍，而是更像生日晚宴现场被围拍时的高奢时尚抓拍。可以适度加入前景遮挡、局部手部入镜、酒杯靠近镜头、手机拍摄画面、纸片飘落等，增强现场感。

【场景设定】
场景为欧式古典私人宴会厅 / 豪宅会客厅 / 生日晚宴现场。包含拱形门窗、复古壁炉、雕花墙面、落地镜、水晶吊灯、香槟塔、长桌、白桌布、银色或金色烛台、玻璃高脚杯、礼物盒、蛋糕、玫瑰花、珍珠链、金色碎纸和彩带。整体氛围要纸醉金迷、奢华璀璨、烛光闪烁、金碧辉煌，像一场顶级财阀千金的私人生日宴。

【服装要求】
服装必须华丽隆重，有强烈的“财阀千金生日主角”视觉。请从以下礼服方向中随机选择 1 套，并在四张小图中保持完全一致：
- 白色蕾丝 / 珠绣高定礼服
- 黑色缎面 / 抹胸鱼尾礼服
- 香槟金珠绣 / 羽毛元素礼服
- 银色亮片 / 高定鱼尾礼服
- 冰蓝色 / 雾蓝色公主纱裙或珠绣礼服

强调亮片、珠绣、缎面、蕾丝、羽毛、立体花、纱层、修身鱼尾等高定材质。允许搭配披肩式西装外套或羽毛披肩，但如果加入，也必须四张统一存在于同一套造型逻辑中，不能忽有忽无、风格断裂。

【妆发与头饰】
妆容必须明显比普通写真更华丽、更重工、更有攻击性。采用精致高定晚宴妆，轮廓立体，底妆通透高级，眉眼锋利，睫毛浓密分明，眼妆精致上扬，唇妆高级有光泽，整体是冷艳美人感，不是清纯甜妹妆。

发型需要更华丽，可以从以下方向中随机选择 1 套，并在四张图中保持一致：
- 高盘发
- 蓬松盘发
- 低盘发
- 大波浪卷发
- 公主头 / 半扎卷发

头上必须加入精致装饰，例如：钻石发箍、珍珠发箍、水晶发针、金属发饰、小型皇冠感 headpiece、蝴蝶结缎带发饰、珠宝发夹等。搭配明显的珠宝首饰，如钻石耳环、长耳坠、项链、choker、手链、戒指。整组四张图必须保持同一套头饰和同一套首饰，不要每张都换。

【候选镜头库】
最终四张图请从以下 7 个镜头中任选 4 个进行组合，不要全部使用，但要确保四张彼此差异明显：

1. 近景高冷特写  
人物靠近镜头，突出妆容、眼神、头饰和珠宝。可以直视镜头，也可以微微侧头、不完全看镜头。表情冷艳克制，像被闪光灯捕捉的高光时刻。

2. 半身宴会举杯抓拍镜头  
人物手持香槟杯或高脚杯，不一定看镜头，可以看向侧方、低头看杯子、与旁边人互动、被喊到名字时回头。画面要有很强的现场抓拍感，前景可有烛台、酒杯、水晶反光。

3. 全身或 3/4 身主角镜头  
完整展示礼服、姿态和主角气场。可以站在香槟塔、壁炉、宴会桌、吊灯下方或拱形门前，像红毯现场主角出场。动作可以是提裙、回眸、扶腰、转身、单手举杯、披外套站立。

4. 互动氛围抓拍镜头  
强调宴会现场互动感。可以有多只手举杯围绕她、有人递酒给她、有人举手机拍她、金色纸片从空中落下、她掩嘴轻笑、侧身回头、抬手整理头发、被众人簇拥。要有“她在现场被围拍”的感觉。

5. 桌边俯身近中景镜头  
人物微微俯身靠近宴会桌、蛋糕、烛台或香槟塔，手臂轻搭桌边，形成更有氛围感的近中景。重点表现肩颈线条、礼服上半身细节、桌面道具和高奢晚宴质感。

6. 坐姿主角镜头  
人物坐在古典扶手椅、宴会椅或桌边座位上，裙摆自然铺开。动作可以是单手扶脸、轻握酒杯、身体微微侧向镜头、目光看向远处或缓慢回头。整体像豪门千金在私人夜宴中的优雅瞬间。

7. 整理发丝 / 头饰镜头  
人物侧身或半侧身，抬手轻触头饰、整理发丝、碰触耳坠或项链，突出发型层次、头饰、珠宝和闪光灯下的高级反光。可以不看镜头，更强调“被抓拍到的造型瞬间”。

【镜头选择规则】
最终四张图建议优先覆盖以下类型，避免内容过于接近：
- 1 张近景高冷特写
- 1 张半身举杯或桌边近中景
- 1 张全身或 3/4 身主角镜头
- 1 张互动氛围或坐姿抓拍镜头

允许 AI 在 7 个镜头中自由选择 4 个最合适的组合，但不要生成 4 张相似角度或相似表情的图。

【表情、视线与姿态】
不要四张都看镜头。请混合使用以下状态：
- 冷冷直视镜头
- 侧头看向远处
- 低头看酒杯
- 回眸
- 被喊到名字时转头
- 半遮笑
- 微微抬下巴
- 慵懒不屑地扫一眼镜头
- 被人簇拥时露出很淡的笑意

整体表情要偏高冷、美艳、克制、疏离，不要甜笑过多，不要少女感卖萌。姿态要修长、从容、有权势感和名媛气场，避免拘谨僵硬。

【光影与质感】
画面主色调为暖金色、奶油金、琥珀金、香槟金。强调烛光、水晶灯、珠宝反光、玻璃折射与闪光灯高光。需要明显的闪光灯拍摄质感：亮面高光、局部过曝反光、前景光斑、真实现场反差。整体像高端时尚杂志与宴会纪实抓拍的结合。可以有轻微胶片感，但重点是“闪光灯下的豪门生日晚宴”。

【避免跑偏】
请避免把人物生成成甜美可爱、温柔乖巧、网红风、普通韩系生日写真或影楼公主风。人物必须更像财阀千金、豪门名媛、红毯主角，气质偏高冷、艳丽、矜贵、疏离，有压场感。不要四张都标准看镜头，不要四张都露出相同笑容，要有更多被闪光灯抓拍到的自然瞬间。

【成片要求】
最终成片必须让人一眼感受到：这是财阀千金的高奢生日宴，而不是普通网红生日写真。人物必须高冷美艳、妆发华丽、头饰精致、礼服隆重、场景纸醉金迷、闪光灯抓拍感强。四张图统一又有变化，每一张都像不同的晚宴高光瞬间。不要出现文字、水印、logo。

title: 沉浸式演唱会大屏粉丝影像
promptEn:
Photorealistic live concert documentary photo, horizontal 4:3 composition, taken from inside a large indoor pop concert arena, showing a giant side LED screen beside the stage displaying a close-up fan-cam shot of a beautiful adult Chinese internet-famous fan sitting in the audience.

The main subject must appear inside the huge LED screen, not as a direct portrait. The real camera is positioned somewhere inside the arena, looking toward the stage-side jumbotron / giant LED screen. The black frame of the massive LED screen, stage truss structure, dark arena ceiling, purple-pink stage lights, and some real audience silhouettes or stage details below the screen should be visible, making it clear that this is a real concert photo of the big screen during a live audience interaction moment.

Inside the LED screen: a close-up broadcast fan-cam image of a beautiful adult Chinese woman sitting among the crowd. She has long softly styled black hair, delicate facial features, bright expressive eyes, smooth natural skin, soft-glam makeup, subtle eyeliner, glossy lips, and an effortlessly attractive influencer-like presence. She is wearing a tasteful but body-flattering off-shoulder knit top in soft lavender or muted black, with a slim silhouette that gently emphasizes her neckline and figure, paired with a delicate necklace and minimal earrings, fashionable, sexy, and eye-catching but not vulgar.

She is making a cute playful wink expression, with one eye closed in a natural charming wink and a soft sweet smile, reacting as if she has just noticed she is being shown on the giant screen. The expression should feel lively, flirty, and adorable, but still natural and candid rather than stiff or overly posed. Her posture is seated and relaxed, surrounded by other audience members holding glowing light sticks and phones.

Inside the screen background: packed concert audience, blurred fans, glowing pink and purple light sticks, phones recording, arena seating, soft bokeh, realistic crowd density. The fan-cam image on the LED screen should feel like a live broadcast close-up from the stage-facing-to-audience camera, with long telephoto compression and shallow depth of field.

Very important visual treatment: this is a photographed giant LED screen, so include subtle LED pixel texture, slight moiré pattern, mild screen-refresh banding, broadcast compression, softened details, slight color shift from the screen, purple-pink cast, imperfect exposure, and a little haze. The screen image should look bright and slightly washed compared to the darker real arena around it.

Camera style: real concert audience photo of a jumbotron, handheld documentary photography, slightly imperfect framing, realistic low-light phone/camera capture, subtle motion softness, slight digital noise, stronger gritty analog-film texture, pronounced coarse grain, cinematic but natural realism. Strong live-event authenticity.

Lighting: dark arena environment, purple and pink stage glow, soft LED screen illumination, low contrast, realistic indoor-night concert lighting, no harsh flash.

Composition: the giant LED screen dominates most of the frame, with the fan-cam close-up filling the screen. Keep visible black screen borders, stage rigging, and a strip of real audience or stage lights at the bottom. The final image should clearly feel like someone inside the concert venue photographed the big screen while the fan appeared on it.

Mood: accidental “caught on the big screen” concert moment, warm and charming, internet-famous fan aesthetic, authentic Chinese pop concert atmosphere, dreamy live-show memory, realistic fan-cam jumbotron moment.

Avoid: pouty lips, double-hand heart gesture, direct selfie portrait, direct fan-cam only without the outer big screen, missing LED screen border, side-view spectator angle, studio portrait, empty arena, fake CGI look, plastic skin, excessive retouching, vulgar exposure, nudity, minors, readable brand logos, watermark, overly sharp commercial beauty photo.
promptCh:
照片级写实现场演唱会纪录照片，水平4:3构图，从大型室内流行音乐演唱会场馆内部拍摄，展示舞台旁的一个巨型侧边LED屏幕，屏幕上显示着一个美丽的中国成年网红粉丝坐在观众席中的特写粉丝镜头。  

主体必须出现在巨大的LED屏幕内部，而不是作为直接肖像。真实相机位于场馆内的某个位置，面向舞台侧的巨型屏幕/大型LED屏幕拍摄。应可见巨型LED屏幕的黑色边框、舞台桁架结构、昏暗的场馆天花板、紫粉色舞台灯光，以及屏幕下方的一些真实观众轮廓或舞台细节，从而明确这是一张演唱会现场观众互动时刻的大屏幕真实照片。  

LED屏幕内部：一个美丽的中国成年女性坐在人群中的特写广播粉丝镜头。她拥有长而柔顺的造型黑发、精致的五官、明亮富有表现力的眼睛、光滑自然的皮肤、柔和的魅力妆容、细微的眼线、光泽的嘴唇，以及一种毫不费力的网红般吸引力。她穿着优雅却凸显身材的露肩针织上衣，颜色为柔和的薰衣草紫或低调的黑色，修长轮廓轻轻强调她的颈线和身形，搭配精致的项链和简约耳环，时尚、性感且引人注目，但不低俗。  

她正做出可爱俏皮的眨眼表情，一只眼睛自然迷人地闭合，伴随柔和甜美的微笑，仿佛刚刚注意到自己被显示在巨型屏幕上。这种表情应感觉生动、调情且可爱，但仍自然而坦率，而不是僵硬或过度摆拍。她的姿势是坐姿且放松，周围是其他观众拿着发光的荧光棒和手机。  

屏幕背景内部：拥挤的演唱会观众、模糊的粉丝、发光的粉紫色荧光棒、正在录像的手机、场馆座位、柔和的散景、真实的观众密度。LED屏幕上的粉丝镜头应感觉像是舞台面向观众的相机直播特写，带有长焦压缩和浅景深。  

非常重要的视觉处理：这是一个被拍摄的巨型LED屏幕，因此包括细微的LED像素纹理、轻微的摩尔纹图案、温和的屏幕刷新条纹、广播压缩、柔化细节、屏幕的轻微色偏、紫粉色色调、不完美的曝光，以及一点雾气。屏幕图像应看起来明亮且略微褪色，与周围较暗的真实场馆形成对比。  

相机风格：巨型屏幕的真实演唱会观众照片，手持纪录摄影，略微不完美的取景、真实的低光手机/相机捕捉、细微的运动柔和、轻微的数字噪点、更强的粗糙胶片纹理、明显的粗颗粒、电影感但自然的现实主义。强烈的现场活动真实感。  

光线：昏暗的场馆环境、紫色和粉色的舞台辉光、柔和的LED屏幕照明、低对比度、真实的室内夜间演唱会照明，没有刺眼的闪光。  

构图：巨型LED屏幕占据画面大部分，粉丝特写充满屏幕。保持可见的黑色屏幕边框、舞台吊装，以及底部的一条真实观众或舞台灯光。最终图像应明确感觉像是演唱会场馆内有人拍摄了大屏幕，而粉丝出现在上面。  

氛围：意外“被大屏幕捕捉”的演唱会瞬间、温暖而迷人、网红粉丝美学、真实的中国特色流行演唱会氛围、梦幻的现场表演记忆、现实的粉丝镜头巨屏时刻。  

避免：撅嘴、双手比心手势、直接自拍肖像、仅直接粉丝镜头而无外部大屏幕、缺失LED屏幕边框、侧视观众角度、摄影棚肖像、空荡场馆、假CGI外观、塑料皮肤、过度修图、低俗暴露、裸露、未成年人、可读品牌标志、水印、过度锐利的商业美照。

title: 具金牛座特质的可爱风海报
promptEn: I am “TAURUS.” Create a poster inspired by Yumi’s Cells with the same soft, aesthetic, slice-of-life vibe and background style, while fully reflecting the Taurus zodiac theme in the design. The subject’s face must remain completely unchanged and untouched. Surround the subject with multiple small, raw yet realistic cute chibi-style mini 3D versions of the subject, designed like expressive “cells” with oversized heads, glossy high-detail finishes, and playful emotions. Each mini character should reflect Taurus traits such as calmness, loyalty, comfort-loving energy, stubbornness, sensuality, patience, and love for luxury and food. Show them in different actions: one clinging onto the subject’s arm, one relaxing with a cozy blanket, one reading a book peacefully, one drinking coffee or tea, one holding snacks or dessert, one lying down using a phone, one refusing to move with a stubborn expression, one looking sleepy and unbothered, and one with soft messy “just woke up” energy. Add playful hand-drawn doodles interacting directly with the subject and chibi characters—outlining poses, sketching comfy cushions, steam from drinks, tiny flowers, sparkle details, and calm motion accents to enhance storytelling. Use a clean aesthetic composition, white sticker outlines, soft pastel sage green, cream, beige, dusty pink, and warm earthy tones, high-detail glossy 3D chibi look, cute Korean-inspired design, with a raw natural poster feel in a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, and the Taurus identity clearly integrated into the overall concept.
promptCh: 我是“金牛座”。创作一张受《Yumi的细胞》启发的海报，保持相同的柔和、唯美、生活片段氛围和背景风格，同时在设计中完全体现金牛座的主题。主体的面部必须保持完全不变和未被触及。用多个小型、原始却逼真的可爱 Q 版迷你 3D 版本的主体包围主体，这些版本设计成富有表现力的“细胞”，拥有超大头部、光泽高细节处理，以及俏皮的情感。每个迷你角色应反映金牛座的特质，如平静、忠诚、热爱舒适的能量、固执、感性、耐心，以及对奢侈品和食物的热爱。展示它们进行不同的动作：一个紧抓主体的手臂，一个裹着舒适的毯子放松，一个平静地阅读书籍，一个喝咖啡或茶，一个拿着零食或甜点，一个躺下玩手机，一个固执地拒绝移动，一个看起来困倦且无动于衷，以及一个带着柔软凌乱的“刚醒来”能量。添加俏皮的手绘涂鸦，直接与主体和 Q 版角色互动——勾勒姿势、素描舒适的靠垫、饮料的蒸汽、小花朵、闪光细节，以及平静的动态强调，以增强叙事性。使用干净的唯美构图、白色贴纸轮廓、柔和的鼠尾草绿、奶油色、米色、尘粉色和温暖的土色调、高细节光泽 3D Q 版外观、可爱的韩式设计风格，带有原始自然的 poster 感，以 9:16 纵向宽高比呈现，并将金牛座身份清晰融入整体概念。

title: 90 年代风高端街头服饰海报
promptEn: A clean editorial fashion advertisement poster on a pale powder-blue studio background with a glossy reflective floor. The composition is vertical and minimal, dominated by oversized bold white condensed sans-serif typography in the background reading “FIT FITS:” on the top line and “Something classy ” below, filling most of the upper half behind the subject. In the top right corner, small white branding text reads “Designed by Shamus.” Centered in the lower middle is an oversized forest-green crewneck sweatshirt standing upright like a sculptural object, with soft heavy cotton fabric, dropped shoulders, extra-long sleeves pooled on the floor, and a small black neck label that reads SHAMUS. On the chest of the sweatshirt is a large abstract collage print made from torn paper fragments in beige, tan, black, gray, white, and vivid red, arranged vertically like layered scraps. Leaning against the right side of the giant sweatshirt is a slim female fashion model with long straight black hair, wearing a matching {argument name="sweatshirt color" default="forest green"} sweatshirt and relaxed wide-leg sweatpants with clean white low-top sneakers. She is posed in profile with a calm detached editorial attitude, one hand in her pocket, her body reclining diagonally against the giant garment, legs extended forward; her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur for an anonymous art-fashion look. The smaller worn sweatshirt has the same abstract torn-paper collage graphic centered on the chest. At the bottom center, add 2 lines of small white copy text: “Made to look brand .” and “Because life feels better when someone’s carrying the weight of the world.” The image should feel like a premium conceptual streetwear campaign from the early 1990s reimagined as contemporary luxury advertising, with crisp studio lighting, soft shadows, subtle floor reflections, precise product focus, surreal scale contrast between the oversized sweatshirt and the model, and a polished magazine-poster aesthetic.
promptCh: 浅粉蓝色工作室背景上的干净编辑时尚广告海报，带有光泽反射地板。构图为垂直且极简，以超大粗体白色缩写无衬线字体为主导，背景中上行显示“FIT FITS：”，下方为“Something classy”，占据主体后上方的大部分空间。右上角，小型白色品牌文字显示“Designed by Shamus。”。下中部中央是一个超大的森林绿圆领毛衣，直立如雕塑物体，采用柔软厚重棉质面料，下垂肩部、超长袖子堆叠在地板上，以及一个小黑色颈标显示 SHAMUS。毛衣胸前是一个大型抽象拼贴印花，由米色、棕褐色、黑色、灰色、白色和鲜艳红色撕裂纸片碎片制成，垂直排列如层层叠加的碎片。倚靠在巨型毛衣右侧的是一个苗条的女性时尚模特，长直黑发，穿着同色{argument name="sweatshirt color" default="forest green"}毛衣和宽松宽腿运动裤，搭配干净的白色低帮运动鞋。她以侧面姿势呈现，带着平静疏离的编辑态度，一手插兜，身体对角倚靠巨型衣物，双腿向前伸展；她的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊遮挡，营造匿名艺术时尚感。较小的穿戴毛衣在胸前中央同样带有相同的抽象撕纸拼贴图形。底部中央添加两行小型白色文案文字：“Made to look brand 。”和“Because life feels better when someone’s carrying the weight of the world。”。图像应营造出一种高端概念街头服饰广告的感觉，仿佛1990年代早期运动重新构想为当代奢侈广告，带有清晰的工作室照明、柔和阴影、微妙地板反射、精准产品焦点、超大毛衣与模特之间的超现实尺度对比，以及精致的杂志海报美学。

promptEn:

title: 森林拍狮冒险故事板信息图
promptEn: Create a cinematic 16-panel storyboard infographic showing the adventure of a young female wildlife photographer traveling into a deep forest to photograph a majestic lion. Use a realistic movie-storyboard style with warm natural colors, dramatic sunlight, jungle atmosphere, cinematic camera angles, and professional wildlife documentary aesthetics. The same realistic young woman should appear consistently in every panel wearing outdoor explorer clothing, hiking boots, backpack, and carrying a professional DSLR camera with a telephoto lens. Arrange the storyboard in a clean 4x4 grid with numbered scenes, bold titles, small bullet points, and visual motion arrows. Scenes should include: preparing camera gear, entering the jungle, walking through trees, spotting animal tracks, hearing movement in bushes, carefully hiding behind rocks, seeing the lion from a distance, adjusting camera settings, slowly approaching, capturing close-up lion shots, filming the lion walking, taking cinematic wildlife photos, reviewing footage on the camera screen, sunset in the jungle, returning safely from the forest, and finally showing the captured lion video proudly on a laptop or camera display. Include realistic forest lighting, dust particles, leaves moving, cinematic shadows, wildlife atmosphere, dramatic expressions, camera close-ups, and emotional storytelling. Ultra-realistic photography style, nature documentary mood, high-detail jungle environment, realistic human appearance, premium cinematic composition, 4K quality, no anime, no cartoon, no CGI look.
promptCh: 创建一张电影风格的 16 格故事板信息图，展示一位年轻女性野生动物摄影师深入茂密森林拍摄雄伟狮子的冒险历程。采用逼真的电影故事板风格，使用温暖的自然色调、戏剧性的阳光、丛林氛围、电影化的摄影角度，以及专业的野生动物纪录片美学。同一名逼真的年轻女性应在每个画面中一致出现，她穿着户外探险服装、登山靴、背包，并携带配备远摄镜头的专业单反相机。将故事板以整洁的 4x4 网格排列，包含编号场景、粗体标题、小型项目符号，以及视觉运动箭头。场景应包括：准备相机装备、进入丛林、穿过树木行走、发现动物足迹、听到灌木丛中的动静、小心躲在岩石后面、从远处看到狮子、调整相机设置、缓慢接近、捕捉狮子近距离镜头、拍摄狮子行走、拍摄电影般的野生动物照片、在相机屏幕上审视镜头、日落时的丛林、从森林安全返回，以及最终在笔记本电脑或相机显示屏上自豪地展示拍摄的狮子视频。包含逼真的森林光线、尘埃颗粒、飘动的树叶、电影般的阴影、野生动物氛围、戏剧性表情、相机特写，以及情感化的叙事。超逼真摄影风格、自然纪录片氛围、高细节丛林环境、逼真人类外貌、高级电影构图、4K 品质、无动漫、无卡通、无 CGI 外观。

在中心附近垂直放置一个大型逼真的 MAYBELLINE FIT ME 遮瑕膏产品瓶，背后带有奶油状遮瑕质地涂抹。背景应为柔和模糊的奢华工作室内部，采用米色调、温暖阳光阴影、极简花卉、大理石表面，以及高端护肤活动氛围。

字体设计应干净而美观：“MAYBELLINE” “FIT ME” “Concealer” “NATURAL. SMOOTH. YOU.”

仅添加 4 个极简功能部分，配以优雅图标：• 自然妆效  
• 中等遮盖力  
• 持久不脱妆  
• 轻盈舒适  

保持布局非常干净高端。移除所有联盟链接、按钮、多余徽章、不必要营销文字和杂乱元素。专注于类似《Vogue》化妆品广告的奢华美容活动美学。

超现实、电影级光线、柔和阴影、光泽肌肤质感、奢华韩式美容活动风格、锐利焦点、高端构图、照片级真实、优雅字体、杂志品质商业设计、4K 横向海报、高细节。

title: 角色分层叙事宣传海报
promptEn: A character promotional poster of [XXX], using a unified vertical key-visual composition. Each poster follows a hierarchical layout with a larger upper section and smaller lower section: the upper half features the character’s most recognizable head, facial contour, mask, or upper-body silhouette as a massive visual centerpiece, forming a highly identifiable silhouette-style dominant shape. The middle and lower section contains the full character as the secondary focal point, standing in a stable pose or subtle motion, creating the visual core of the composition. Inside the large silhouette and around the character, use double exposure and collage-style narrative composition, blending multiple scenes, symbolic imagery, small character interactions, supporting elements, and environments layered into mist, ink-wash textures, and negative space. Symmetrical or echoing side sub-scenes are placed on the left and right to create narrative tension and spatial variation. A flowing visual line runs vertically through the entire composition, connecting the main character, internal collage, and upper silhouette, enhancing visual unity and guiding the viewer’s eye. The overall image should preserve large areas of negative space, while the edges use ink diffusion, blur, and fragmented fading effects to create the balance of emptiness and solidity found in Eastern aesthetics, with a breathable sense of space. The overall style should remain unified, premium, restrained, and cinematic, emphasizing layering, storytelling, key visual impact, and a cohesive series-poster visual language.
promptCh: 一张 [XXX] 角色宣传海报，采用统一的纵向关键视觉构图。每张海报遵循分层布局，上半部分较大，下半部分较小：上半部分以角色最具辨识度的头部、面部轮廓、面具或上半身剪影作为巨大的视觉中心，形成高度可识别的剪影式主导形状。中部和下部包含完整角色作为次要焦点，以稳定姿势或微妙动作站立，构成构图的视觉核心。在大型剪影内部和角色周围，使用双重曝光和拼贴式叙事构图，将多个场景、象征性图像、小型角色互动、辅助元素和环境层叠融入雾气、水墨纹理和负空间。对称或呼应的侧面子场景放置在左右两侧，以创造叙事张力和空间变化。一条流动的视觉线垂直贯穿整个构图，连接主要角色、内部拼贴和上部剪影，提升视觉统一性并引导观者视线。整体图像应保留大片负空间，而边缘使用墨汁扩散、模糊和碎片渐隐效果，创造东方美学中虚实平衡的空灵空间感。整体风格应保持统一、高端、克制且电影化，强调层次感、叙事性、关键视觉冲击力和连贯的系列海报视觉语言。

title: 少女时尚角色介绍海报
promptEn:
Create an ultra high-quality 9:16 character introduction poster based on the reference image. Preserve the same young woman’s facial identity, face shape, skin tone, long dark hair, soft sweet temperament, and recognizable overall appearance.

Transform her into a stylish fashion-forward character with a sweet yet cool personality. Replace her original outfit with a trendy contemporary street-fashion look: layered cream and beige clothing, cropped top or fitted inner layer, lightweight jacket, short skirt or shorts, stylish belt, metallic chain accessories, bracelets, necklace, fashion bag, slouchy leg warmers, and chunky platform sneakers. The outfit should feel youthful, trendy, elegant, and cohesive.

The main character should appear as a full-body hero portrait in the center of the poster, posing confidently with a cool attitude while giving a sweet playful wink. Her pose should feel fashionable, relaxed, and editorial.

Design the poster as a rich multi-panel character profile layout. Around the central figure, add several irregular cinematic inset frames showing different details of the same character: eyes, hair, waist, hands, legs, face, and feet. Each inset frame must show a different angle, different crop, and different pose or gesture. The panels should overlap and interweave at different depths, creating an irregular layered collage composition with strong visual rhythm.

Add modern trendy graphic elements: translucent panels, chrome accents, metallic heart stickers, star sparkles, thin framing lines, grid patterns, barcode-style labels, tape details, motion lines, handwritten notes, fashion magazine typography, and stylish character information blocks. Include clean English poster text such as “CHARACTER INTRODUCTION”, “EYES”, “HAIR”, “WAIST”, “HANDS”, “LEGS”, “FACE”, and “FEET”. Keep the text elegant, minimal, and visually integrated.

Use a soft cream, beige, ivory, and light metallic color palette. The background should be clean but visually rich, with subtle depth, soft studio lighting, layered shadows, and premium editorial design. The overall poster should feel trendy, innovative, sweet, cool, polished, and commercially finished.

Ultra high resolution, ultra detailed, realistic skin texture, natural facial features, beautiful hair strands, clean makeup, accurate anatomy, elegant hands, realistic legs and feet, crisp fabric texture, premium fashion editorial photography, soft cinematic lighting, refined composition, high-end character design poster, visually fresh and stylish.
promptCh:
根据参考图像，创作一张超高质量的9:16角色介绍海报。保留相同的年轻女性的面部特征、脸型、肤色、长黑发、柔和甜美的气质以及可辨识的整体外貌。

将她转变为一个时尚前卫的角色，拥有甜美却酷炫的个性。用潮流当代街头时尚造型替换她原本的服装：分层奶油色和米色服装、短款上衣或贴身内搭、轻薄夹克、短裙或短裤、时尚腰带、金属链条配饰、手链、项链、时尚手袋、宽松腿部保暖套以及厚底平台运动鞋。整体造型应显得年轻、潮流、优雅且协调统一。

主要角色应以全身英雄肖像形式出现在海报中央，以自信的酷炫姿态摆姿，带着甜美俏皮的眨眼。她的姿势应感觉时尚、放松且富有编排感。

将海报设计成丰富的多面板角色简介布局。在中心人物周围，添加几个不规则的电影式嵌入框架，展示同一角色的不同细节：眼睛、头发、腰部、手部、腿部、脸部和脚部。每个嵌入框架必须展示不同的角度、不同的裁剪以及不同的姿势或手势。这些面板应在不同深度上重叠和交织，营造出不规则的分层拼贴构图，带有强烈的视觉节奏。

添加现代潮流图形元素：半透明面板、铬色点缀、金属心形贴纸、星星闪光、细框线、网格图案、条码式标签、胶带细节、动态线条、手写笔记、时尚杂志排版以及时尚的角色信息块。包含简洁的英文海报文本，如“CHARACTER INTRODUCTION”、“EYES”、“HAIR”、“WAIST”、“HANDS”、“LEGS”、“FACE”和“FEET”。文本应保持优雅、简约，并与视觉元素完美融合。

使用柔和的奶油色、米色、象牙白和浅金属色调色板。背景应干净但视觉丰富，带有微妙深度、柔和工作室照明、分层阴影以及高端编排设计。整体海报应感觉潮流、创新、甜美、酷炫、精致且商业化完成。

超高分辨率、超精细细节、逼真皮肤纹理、自然面部特征、精美发丝、干净妆容、精准解剖结构、优雅手部、逼真腿部和脚部、清晰织物质感、高端时尚编排摄影、柔和电影式照明、精炼构图、高端角色设计海报，视觉上清新且时尚。

title: 王者荣耀英雄游戏海报
promptCh:
一张高端游戏角色宣传海报，竖版构图，超近景半身特写。画面主体是一位冷峻神秘的年轻男性幻想角色，拥有银白色蓬松碎发，发丝细腻、层次丰富，头顶有明显的白色狼耳或兽耳，气质冷静、危险、克制。角色的脸部只露出一半，另一半被一把巨大的未来感狙击枪或重型机械武器遮挡，形成强烈的视觉压迫感。只露出一只眼睛，眼神锐利、安静、带有猎手般的压迫感。

角色穿着深蓝色、黑色与金属金点缀结合的高领战斗服与轻甲，材质高级，包含皮革、金属、机械装甲结构与微微发亮的能量元件。领口高耸包裹脖颈，肩部有硬质护甲，服装质感厚重、冷峻、精密。武器靠近镜头，占据画面右侧大面积空间，设计为 futuristic sniper rifle，具有黑金金属结构、精细雕纹、机械分段、蓝色发光能量仓或瞄准模块，细节复杂，带有高科技与王者系幻想风格结合的感觉。

背景为朦胧的冷色幻想战场或远景城堡废墟，整体虚化处理，以蓝灰色、雾气、微光和远方火光构成氛围。空气中漂浮雪花、碎冰、光尘、白色粒子，营造寒冷、肃杀、静谧的氛围。光线来自背后与侧上方，形成柔和的逆光与轮廓光，照亮银白头发边缘和武器金属边缘，使角色更立体。整体色调以冷蓝、灰白、深海军蓝、金属黑和少量暗金为主，氛围电影感强。

海报左侧加入大面积中国书法风标题字，笔触凌厉、泼墨感强，深蓝色墨迹质感；旁边配小号竖排罗马字母和排版说明文字，形成游戏角色名海报设计。下方加入细长的小字 slogan 和英文排版，整体像顶级 MOBA 手游的英雄宣传海报。顶部可放一个低调金色游戏品牌标记或抽象徽章，底部加入居中的系列标语排版。

风格关键词：高端游戏海报、男性英雄角色、半脸遮挡构图、超近景特写、银白狼耳少年、未来狙击枪、冷色电影感、王者荣耀风格、国风书法标题、蓝黑金配色、雪粒子、幻想战场背景、精致发丝、锐利眼神、高细节材质、顶级手游宣传视觉、史诗感、压迫感、帅气、神秘、超清细节。

title: 温迪快餐的游戏风广告海报
promptEn:
Create a premium vertical advertising poster for Wendy’s with a strong visual atmosphere inspired by iconic video game cover art aesthetics. The poster should combine the energetic identity of the Wendy’s product with dramatic game-cover-style composition, cinematic visual storytelling, and highly stylized promotional design elements. Include bold typography, layered graphic ornaments, decorative elements, dynamic textures, visual effects, and artistic embellishments that strongly capture the mood, energy, and immersive feeling of a modern game cover while still maintaining the branding and appeal of a professional fast-food advertisement.
The overall layout should feel intense, stylish, and visually striking, featuring strong focal points, cinematic depth, dramatic lighting, and highly polished commercial composition. Add thematic decorations inspired by video game cover designs such as glowing accents, action-driven composition, motion graphics, layered shapes, futuristic overlays, stylized particles, dramatic shadows, atmospheric smoke, light streaks, abstract gaming-inspired textures, and immersive background details that enhance the visual storytelling without making the poster look overcrowded. Humanity really looked at burgers and thought, “this should feel like the main character entering the final boss arena.” Somehow it works.
The subject’s pose must NOT look identical to the reference photo. Recreate the pose with a fresh composition that feels more dynamic, elegant, and expressive. The facial expression and body posture should feel alive, charismatic, natural, and emotionally engaging, avoiding stiff, flat, awkward, or lifeless posing. The model should have the confident elegance and fashionable presence commonly seen in international commercial fashion campaigns and premium entertainment posters. The body language should feel cinematic, stylish, and full of movement, as if captured during a dramatic promotional scene rather than a static studio shot.
The outfit should feature modern casual street-fashion styling with contemporary layering, fashionable cuts, varied textures, visually interesting patterns, and balanced color combinations that avoid looking plain or repetitive. Mix stylish modern fashion elements that complement the Wendy’s branding while still maintaining a high-end editorial and entertainment-inspired aesthetic. The clothing should feel trendy, youthful, premium, and visually dynamic rather than minimal or monotonous.
Integrate bold and stylish typography placement throughout the composition, inspired by cinematic game cover layouts and modern advertising campaigns. Use visually impactful title design, supporting text elements, layered graphic framing, and decorative visual accents that help create a premium poster identity. Add realistic food details such as floating ingredients, burger layers, sauce splashes, crumbs, steam, glossy highlights, and packaging elements blended naturally into the dramatic game-cover-inspired environment.
Use cinematic lighting, realistic reflections, high-detail textures, dramatic contrast, premium color grading, ultra-sharp focus, and immersive depth to create a luxurious commercial-quality result. The final artwork should feel like a fusion between a AAA video game cover and a world-class fast-food advertising campaign, rendered in ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high-end commercial style with professional composition and ultra high-definition 8K
promptCh:
为 Wendy’s 创建一张高级垂直广告海报，采用标志性视频游戏封面艺术美学作为灵感，营造强烈的视觉氛围。海报应将 Wendy’s 产品的活力身份与戏剧性的游戏封面式构图、电影般的视觉叙事以及高度风格化的促销设计元素相结合。包含大胆的字体排版、分层图形装饰、装饰元素、动态纹理、视觉效果以及艺术修饰，这些元素应强烈捕捉现代游戏封面的氛围、能量和沉浸感，同时仍保持专业快餐广告的品牌形象和吸引力。
整体布局应给人强烈、时尚且视觉冲击的感觉，突出强烈的焦点、电影般的深度、戏剧性照明以及高度精致的商业构图。添加受视频游戏封面设计启发的主题装饰，例如发光点缀、动作驱动的构图、动态图形、分层形状、未来主义叠加、风格化粒子、戏剧性阴影、大气烟雾、光线条纹、抽象游戏启发纹理，以及增强视觉叙事的沉浸式背景细节，这些细节不会让海报显得拥挤。人类真的审视汉堡并想，“这应该感觉像主角进入最终 Boss 竞技场。”不知何故，它奏效了。
主体的姿势绝不能与参考照片完全相同。以全新的构图重现姿势，使其感觉更具动态、优雅和表现力。面部表情和身体姿势应感觉生动、魅力十足、自然且情感引人，避免僵硬、平淡、尴尬或毫无生气的姿势。模特应具备国际商业时尚活动和高级娱乐海报中常见的自信优雅和时尚存在感。肢体语言应感觉电影化、时尚且充满动感，仿佛捕捉到戏剧性促销场景中而非静态工作室拍摄。

title: 中文科技新闻爆款封面生成器
promptCh:
你是一名顶级中文科技媒体视觉设计师。

你的任务是：

根据用户输入的一整篇文章内容，自动提取核心新闻、关键数字、核心产品、行业情绪和信息层级，并生成一张高冲击力的中文科技新闻文章封面图。

图片比例：16:9 横版。

---

【整体风格】

生成一张「中文科技媒体爆款封面图」。

整体风格参考：

* 中国科技媒体头图
* B站科技区爆款缩略图
* 财经新闻视觉
* 游戏行业信息图
* 高冲击力 YouTube Thumbnail
* “行业突发新闻”视觉风格

要求：

* 强烈视觉冲击
* 信息密度高
* 3 秒内看懂新闻重点
* 专业媒体感
* 大量数据卡片
* 中文粗黑大标题
* 明确的产品主视觉
* 明确的情绪表达
* 不要极简风
* 不要 Apple 风
* 不要电影海报风
* 要像“行业大事件”

---

【自动分析文章】

你必须先自动从文章中提取：

1. 最适合作为封面的主标题
2. 最有冲击力的副标题
3. 最重要的数字
4. 最大涨幅、跌幅或变化幅度
5. 最核心的产品、品牌或人物
6. 最能制造视觉冲击的信息
7. 用户最关心的结论
8. 文章整体情绪

文章情绪可以是：

* 暴涨
* 暴跌
* 涨价
* 崩盘
* 封禁
* 突破
* 发布
* 革命
* 危机
* 反转
* 震动
* 警告
* 机会
* 行业洗牌

然后把这些信息转化为视觉设计。

---

【构图结构】

画面采用高密度信息图式布局，自动生成以下区域：

1. 顶部新闻区

* 放品牌名、产品名或行业标签
* 加入“突发”“官方宣布”“重磅”“最新”“行业震动”等新闻标签
* 标签内容根据文章情绪自动选择

2. 中央超大标题区

* 使用超巨大中文标题
* 字体粗壮
* 强烈立体感
* 可带轻微破损、压迫、速度或科技纹理
* 关键词用高亮色突出
* 标题必须短、狠、直接
* 让读者 3 秒内知道发生了什么

3. 主视觉产品区

* 自动识别文章中的核心产品、品牌、设备、人物或象征物
* 将其作为画面最大视觉主体之一
* 产品应有透视感、层次感、光效和冲击力
* 背后可以加入行情图、能量光、箭头、爆炸线、科技 HUD、速度线等元素

4. 数据卡片区

自动把文章中的关键信息做成多个卡片，包括但不限于：

* 价格变化
* 涨跌幅
* 时间节点
* 地区差异
* 销量
* 成本
* 市值
* 用户影响
* 行业对比

数据卡片要求：

* 旧数据可以使用删除线
* 新数据必须更醒目
* 百分比、金额、时间必须突出
* 每张卡片只表达一个重点
* 卡片之间层级清晰，不要堆成一团

5. 底部总结区

自动提取文章中的 3–5 个结论，做成图标化摘要：

* 原因
* 影响
* 趋势
* 风险
* 机会
* 用户建议
* 行业判断

每个结论用「图标 + 短句」呈现。

---

【配色策略】

不要固定使用某一种配色。
你必须根据文章的行业、品牌、情绪和新闻性质，自动生成一套高冲击力封面配色。

配色必须遵循以下原则：

1. 品牌优先

如果文章中出现明确品牌、产品或公司，优先提取其品牌识别色作为主色调。
但不要机械复制 Logo 颜色，要转化为更适合封面的高对比视觉系统。

2. 情绪优先

根据新闻情绪自动选择色彩方向：

* 涨价、危机、封禁、暴雷、裁员、监管、事故：
  使用高压迫感、高警示感、高对比色彩。

* 发布、升级、突破、胜利、增长：
  使用更明亮、更有能量的科技色彩。

* AI、芯片、未来科技、模型发布：
  使用冷色科技感配色。

* 财经、股价、市值、成本、价格：
  使用金融信息图配色。

* 游戏、娱乐、消费电子：
  使用更强烈、更年轻、更商业化的高饱和配色。

3. 对比关系

画面必须建立清晰的对比层级：

* 背景色：负责情绪氛围
* 主标题色：必须与背景形成强烈反差
* 重点数字色：必须是全图最醒目的颜色之一
* 辅助信息色：降低饱和度，避免抢主标题
* 警示/强调色：只用于关键词、箭头、涨跌幅和标签

4. 色彩数量控制

整张图控制在 3–5 个主要颜色内：

* 1 个主背景色
* 1 个品牌/主题主色
* 1 个强强调色
* 1 个文字高对比色
* 1 个辅助信息色

不要使用过多杂乱颜色。
即使信息密度很高，配色也必须统一。

5. 信息情绪匹配

配色必须服务于文章核心情绪：

* 坏消息：压迫感、警示感、冲击感
* 好消息：爆发感、速度感、未来感
* 行业分析：专业感、数据感、冷静但有冲击力
* 消费建议：让用户一眼看到风险、机会或行动窗口

6. 禁止事项

* 不要默认使用红黑配色
* 不要使用柔和小清新配色，除非文章本身是生活方式、教育、亲子、文艺类主题
* 不要使用低对比配色
* 不要让背景色、标题色和数字色互相打架
* 不要因为品牌色存在，就牺牲可读性

---

【字体】

* 中文超粗黑体
* 大标题必须极其醒目
* 数字和百分比必须巨大
* 重要数字可以使用描边、阴影、立体效果
* 字体要有新闻冲击感
* 不要使用纤细字体
* 不要使用文艺字体

---

【背景】

根据文章情绪自动选择背景元素：

* 财经/涨跌类：行情图、上涨/下跌箭头、数字网格、金融曲线
* AI/科技类：HUD、芯片纹理、发光线条、数据流
* 游戏/消费电子类：产品光效、速度线、爆炸形状、品牌元素
* 危机/监管类：警示纹理、印章、封条、暗色压迫背景
* 发布/突破类：光束、能量环、未来感渐变、发光粒子

背景不能太空。
但也不能干扰标题和数字阅读。

---

【排版原则】

* 信息密度高，但层级必须清晰
* 一眼先看标题
* 第二眼看产品
* 第三眼看关键数字
* 第四眼看细节卡片
* 所有文字必须尽量清晰可读
* 中文排版要像专业媒体编辑做的封面
* 不要平均用力
* 不要把所有信息做得一样大

---

【输出要求】

最终输出一张：

* 专业
* 高冲击力
* 媒体级
* 中文科技新闻封面图
* 16:9 横版
* 信息密集但清晰
* 适合作为公众号、视频封面、文章头图使用

---

【用户文章】

title: 韩国女生户外低角度阳光自拍
promptEn: A realistic outdoor low-angle smartphone selfie. The subject is a young adult Korean woman standing beneath a clear blue sky filled with large white clouds. The camera is positioned below her waist and angled upward, creating a strong wide-angle perspective. She looks down at the lens with a calm, detached, and relaxed expression, her lips slightly parted in a natural way, without an intentional smile. She has striking, refined beauty that effortlessly draws attention. Her hair is long and light blonde, with thick bangs covering her forehead. A few loose strands are blown by the wind, catching subtle highlights in the sunlight. She has large double eyelids, a well-defined nose bridge, and slightly glossy lips.  She is wearing a light gray ribbed knit long-sleeve top, with one hand lifting the hem upward. The fabric forms realistic diagonal folds and layered bunching across the chest. The visual focus is on the close-up view of her abdomen, waistline, and the skin below the ribcage, while the lower edge of the chest is partially obscured by the clothing and camera angle. Her skin has a light warm tone, with peach-pink and golden highlights under strong natural sunlight. Visible details include realistic pores, a slight sheen of sweat, subtle navel detail, and soft natural skin texture, giving the impression of sun-warmed skin with a faintly moist surface. The edge of the clothing and the white earphone cable cast thin, hard-edged shadows across her abdomen.  White wired earphones hang down from her ears, forming a large curved line in the foreground, with part of the cable passing across the abdominal area. Small silver earrings are also visible. The background contains only a bright blue sky, white clouds, thin cloud streaks, and a few distant dark specks, creating the feeling of a casual snapshot taken outdoors on a summer afternoon.  The photography style is raw smartphone photography, a low-angle sky selfie, in a vertical 3:4 composition, shot with a smartphone wide-angle lens and a relatively deep depth of field, keeping the subject, hand, cable, and sky all mostly in clear focus.
promptCh: 一个逼真的户外低角度智能手机自拍。主体是一位年轻成年韩国女性，站在晴朗的蓝天之下，天空布满大片白色云朵。相机位于她的腰部以下，向上倾斜，营造出强烈的广角视角。她低头看着镜头，表情平静、疏离且放松，嘴唇微微张开，以自然的方式，没有刻意的微笑。她拥有引人注目的精致美貌，轻而易举地吸引注意力。她的头发是长而浅金色的，厚厚的刘海遮住额头。几缕散乱的发丝被风吹起，在阳光下捕捉到微妙的高光。她有大而双眼皮的眼睛、轮廓分明的鼻梁，以及略带光泽的嘴唇。她穿着浅灰色罗纹针织长袖上衣，一只手向上提起衣摆。面料形成逼真的对角褶皱，并在胸部区域产生层层堆叠。视觉焦点集中在腹部、腰线以及肋骨下方皮肤的特写视图上，而胸部的下缘部分被衣物和相机角度遮挡。她的皮肤带有浅暖色调，在强烈的自然阳光下呈现桃粉色和金色高光。可见细节包括逼真的毛孔、轻微的汗水光泽、细微的肚脐细节，以及柔和自然的皮肤纹理，给人一种阳光温暖、表面微微湿润的皮肤印象。衣物边缘和白色耳机线在她的腹部投下细薄、边缘锐利的阴影。白色有线耳机从她的耳朵垂下，在前景形成一条大大的曲线，部分线缆横过腹部区域。小巧的银色耳环也清晰可见。背景仅包含明亮的蓝天、白色云朵、细长的云纹，以及几点遥远的黑色斑点，营造出夏日午后户外随意快照的感觉。摄影风格是原始的智能手机摄影，低角度天空自拍，采用垂直 3:4 构图，使用智能手机广角镜头拍摄，并具有相对较深的景深，使主体、手部、线缆和天空均保持清晰焦点。

title: 9:16 竖版东方幻梦美女图
promptCh:
一位东方幻想成年美女正缓缓走向一面高大的镜子，画面为 9:16 竖版构图，摄像机位于她的左后方，以略带电影感的中远景视角捕捉她的身影。她是画面的绝对视觉中心，背影优雅迷人，身穿一袭华贵的红色礼服，礼服具有高级定制感，面料精致，细节丰富，带有层叠刺绣、珠饰或立体纹理。礼服为露肩设计，并带有深 V 领口，整体华丽、性感但高级克制，充分展现肩颈线条、锁骨气质与身体曲线。

她正朝镜子走去，身体以背面和左后侧为主，姿态优雅从容。镜子中清晰映出她的正面形象，镜中她的面容精致美丽，神情安静而富有故事感，同时可以看到她优美的锁骨，以及饱满胸部上半部分自然柔和的轮廓，整体呈现高级、唯美、迷人的女性气质。

在镜子四周以及画面周围，漂浮着大量破碎镜片，这些镜片是不规则的形状，边缘锐利但具有艺术感，如同时间被打碎后悬浮在空气中。有些碎镜中，映照出她过去与未来不同的样子：有的更年轻纯真，有的成熟冷艳，有的高贵神秘，有的未来感十足，有的带有不同年龄、不同气质、不同命运阶段的她。镜中形象都要保持同一人物的核心辨识度，但在妆容、发型、服饰、气质和时代感上有所区别，形成“同一个人不同人生切片”的感觉。

整个空间梦幻、神秘、唯美，光线以柔和光为主，镜子与碎镜边缘折射出红色、金色、银色与微冷白光，空气中带有轻微雾气、微粒、反射光斑与体积光。整体氛围像梦境、记忆与未来交汇的瞬间，华丽而富有叙事感。画面采用3D CG插画风格，整体明亮，精致、高级、细节丰富

title: 精致个人品牌视觉板拼贴
promptEn:
A sophisticated personal branding vision board collage titled ‘BUILT DIFFERENT’, designed in a premium scrapbook-inspired editorial aesthetic. The composition features multiple high-fashion lifestyle photographs of the same recurring doll-like female character IP with glossy dark black hair styled in voluminous soft curls, oversized expressive dark eyes, rosy cheeks, a tiny button nose, and elegant sunglasses. She wears stylish monochrome black outfits and appears in different aspirational scenes: working on a laptop in a modern studio, holding a professional camera, journaling in a café, walking through an urban setting, and sitting confidently at a minimalist workspace.

The entire layout uses layered torn-paper collage techniques with realistic paper textures, ripped edges, matte magazine cutouts, transparent tape overlays, brown masking tape, spiral notebook scraps, sticky notes, coffee stains, ink splatters, and subtle shadow layering for a tactile handcrafted appearance.

Scattered throughout the design are motivational quotes and handwritten journal notes in a mix of elegant script typography and bold serif headlines, including phrases like ‘discipline today, freedom tomorrow’ and ‘Creating my own story.’ A modern social-media profile mockup prominently displays the brand name ‘LuciaAI’ while preserving the rest of the original branding aesthetic. Additional graphic details include a ‘GOALS’ checklist on lined spiral notebook paper, handwritten annotations, editorial layout markers, and soft gold accent graphics.

The color palette is sophisticated monochrome with warm beige, cream, charcoal black, and muted gold highlights. High-end editorial lighting, realistic matte paper textures, organized-chaos composition, luxury lifestyle branding aesthetic, cinematic photography styling, and modern social-media mood-board design create an inspirational and visually cohesive personal-branding collage.

title: 极简风日式寿司菜谱卡
promptEn:
Create a visually stunning, modern recipe card for “Sushi (Japanese Style)” designed for social media sharing.

Style:
Minimal yet artistic. Blend clean layout with soft Japanese-inspired design. Use rice paper textures, brush strokes, and elegant typography. Balanced negative space with a calm, premium feel.

Layout:
Single-page vertical composition (not a collage), divided into clear sections with visual hierarchy.

Top Section:
- Title: “Sushi”
- Subtitle: “fresh • delicate • handmade”
- A beautiful hero image of sushi (nigiri + maki) with soft natural lighting

Middle Section (Ingredients):
- Cleanly arranged ingredient list with small icons:
  rice, vinegar, fish, seaweed (nori), vegetables
- Minimal bullet points, neat alignment

Lower Section (Steps with Visual Flow):
Include 4–5 steps with small supporting visuals or icons:
1. Prepare and season sushi rice
2. Slice fresh fish neatly
3. Place rice and shape nigiri or roll maki
4. Cut rolls evenly
5. Plate with soy sauce and wasabi

Add thin connecting lines or arrows for flow.

Side Element:
- Small tip box:
  “Use slightly warm rice for best texture”
- Optional ratio note: rice vinegar mix

Design Details:
- Soft neutral colors (white, beige, light grey, subtle red accents)
- Japanese brush-style dividers
- Tiny doodles (chopsticks, fish, rice grains)
- Clean, uncluttered layout

Mood:
Calm, refined, elegant, satisfying to look at

Composition:
Highly balanced, lots of breathing space, premium editorial feel

Aspect ratio:
Vertical (2:3), high resolution, Instagram/Pinterest ready
promptCh:
为“寿司（日式）”创建一张视觉惊艳、现代的食谱卡片，专为社交媒体分享设计。

风格：
极简却富有艺术感。将简洁布局与柔和的日式设计灵感融合。使用米纸纹理、毛笔笔触和优雅的字体设计。平衡留白空间，营造平静、高端的感觉。

布局：
单页纵向构图（非拼贴），分为清晰的部分，具备视觉层级。

顶部区域：
- 标题：“寿司”
- 副标题：“新鲜 • 精致 • 手工制作”
- 一张寿司（握寿司 + 卷寿司）的精美主图，使用柔和的自然光线照明

中间区域（食材）：
- 整洁排列的食材列表，配以小图标：
  米饭、醋、鱼、海苔、蔬菜
- 极简的项目符号，整齐对齐

下部区域（步骤与视觉流程）：
包含 4–5 个步骤，配以小型辅助视觉元素或图标：
1. 准备并调味寿司米饭
2. 整齐切片新鲜鱼肉
3. 放置米饭并塑造握寿司或卷制卷寿司
4. 均匀切割卷寿司
5. 摆盘配以酱油和芥末

添加细线或箭头以示流程。

侧边元素：
- 小提示框：
  “使用微温米饭以获得最佳质感”
- 可选比例说明：米醋混合比例

设计细节：
- 柔和的中性色调（白色、米色、浅灰色、微妙的红色点缀）
- 日式毛笔风格的分隔线
- 微小涂鸦（筷子、鱼、米粒）
- 简洁、无杂乱的布局

氛围：
平静、精致、优雅、赏心悦目

构图：
高度平衡，留有大量呼吸空间，高端编辑风格

宽高比：
纵向（2:3），高分辨率，适合 Instagram/Pinterest

title: 迪奥釉彩欲望美妆大片
promptEn:
ULTRA-REALISTIC DIOR BEAUTY CAMPAIGN, CINEMATIC 6-IMAGE GRID SYSTEM (3x2), HIGH-END LUXURY COSMETIC EDITORIAL, GLOBAL BEAUTY CAMPAIGN AESTHETIC, INSPIRED BY OFFICIAL DIOR BEAUTY VISUAL LANGUAGE, FENTY BEAUTY GRID BALANCE, PARISIAN LUXURY MINIMALISM, AND PREMIUM BEAUTY COMMERCIAL PHOTOGRAPHY
THIS IS NOT RANDOM AI CONTENT.

THIS MUST FEEL LIKE: a real luxury beauty campaign launch art-directed by a global beauty creative director for Dior Beauty.
EVERY FRAME MUST FEEL: editorial, intentional, balanced, premium, human, luxurious, emotionally paced.

CAMPAIGN TITLE:
“GLAZED DESIRE”
STRICT CONSISTENCY MODE (CRITICAL)
ALL 6 FRAMES MUST FEATURE: the exact same Dior Addict Lip Glow Oil, same transparent glossy pink shade, same chrome silver cap, same Dior logo placement, same gloss texture, same color science, same lighting style, same environment tone, same editorial realism.

ALL FRAMES MUST FEEL: shot during the same luxury campaign production.
NO mixed aesthetics. NO random compositions. NO inconsistent lighting.
PRODUCT LOCK (CRITICAL)
Dior Addict Lip Glow Oil, transparent glossy pink lip oil, silver chrome cap, realistic Dior logo, true-to-product proportions, luxury reflective packaging, wet glossy texture realism.
NO redesign. NO fake branding. NO distorted packaging. NO fantasy cosmetics.
CORE EMOTIONAL DIRECTION
luxury intimacy, hydrated sensuality, soft femininity, quiet confidence, editorial beauty, dreamlike softness, Parisian elegance, beauty obsession, expensive minimalism, human warmth.

THIS CAMPAIGN SHOULD FEEL: soft, touchable, addictive, editorial, emotionally luxurious.
VISUAL LANGUAGE
clean Dior beauty aesthetic, airy luxury atmosphere, minimal editorial framing, controlled reflections, soft translucency, expensive simplicity, luxury beauty storytelling, high-end commercial beauty photography.

VISUAL RHYTHM MUST MATTER: some frames calm, some dense, some intimate, some product-heavy, some emotionally human.

COLOR SCIENCE
soft blush pink, milky nude pink, pearl white, translucent gloss tones, rosy undertones, subtle chrome silver reflections.
NO oversaturation. NO neon pink. NO dark grading. NO harsh contrast.

COLORS MUST FEEL: expensive, soft, editorial, airy, timeless.

LIGHTING SYSTEM
soft luxury daylight studio lighting, diffused editorial illumination, hydrated glossy highlights, natural reflective behavior, soft shadow transitions, luxury skin glow.
NO harsh shadows. NO dramatic cinematic darkness.

LIGHT SHOULD FEEL: softly wrapped around skin and product.
CAMERA SYSTEM
85mm luxury beauty lens, 100mm macro beauty lens, shallow depth of field, editorial beauty framing, luxury commercial realism, soft focus falloff.

MODEL SYSTEM
female luxury beauty model, soft feminine features, hydrated glowing skin, minimal Dior-inspired makeup, naturally glossy lips, subtle elegant expressions, editorial realism.

NO exaggerated fashion posing. NO uncanny AI beauty. NO over-retouched skin. NO heavy makeup.

MODEL SHOULD FEEL: expensive, real, elegant, aspirational.

TEXTURE REALISM (CRITICAL)
ultra-realistic wet gloss, hydrated lip reflections, visible lip texture, realistic skin pores, luxury glass transparency, accurate chrome reflections, true-to-life cosmetic realism.

NO plastic skin. NO waxy lips. NO fake gloss. NO AI smoothing.

ENVIRONMENT SYSTEM
minimal Dior beauty studio, soft pink-white luxury gradients, airy negative space, glossy reflective surfaces, subtle translucent reflections, editorial softness.
NO clutter. NO chaotic props. NO excessive fantasy liquids.

ENVIRONMENT SHOULD FEEL: controlled, expensive, minimal, editorial.
GRID BALANCE SYSTEM (MOST IMPORTANT)
THE GRID MUST FOLLOW THIS EXACT VISUAL RHYTHM:
TOP ROW: HUMAN → MACRO → PRODUCT
BOTTOM ROW: TEXTURE → HUMAN → HUMAN/LIP DETAIL
THIS CREATES: editorial balance, visual movement, luxury pacing, high-end campaign flow.
promptCh:
超现实迪奥美妆广告，电影感6图像网格系统（3x2），高端奢侈化妆品编辑摄影，全球美妆广告美学，受官方迪奥美妆视觉语言启发，FENTY BEAUTY网格平衡，巴黎奢侈极简主义，以及高端美妆商业摄影

每个画面必须感觉：编辑化、有意、平衡、高端、人类、奢华、情感节奏。

广告标题：
“釉欲”
严格一致性模式（关键）
所有6个画面必须包含：完全相同的迪奥瘾君子唇彩油，相同的透明光泽粉色调，相同的铬银色瓶盖，相同的迪奥标志位置，相同的润泽质感，相同的色彩科学，相同的照明风格，相同的环境色调，相同的编辑现实主义。

所有画面必须感觉：拍摄于同一奢侈广告制作中。
无混合美学。无随机构图。无不一致照明。
产品锁定（关键）
迪奥瘾君子唇彩油，透明光泽粉色唇油，银铬色瓶盖，逼真迪奥标志，忠实产品比例，奢侈反射包装，湿润光泽质感现实主义。
无重新设计。无假冒品牌。无扭曲包装。无幻想化妆品。
核心情感方向
奢侈亲密感，水润感性，柔和女性气质，安静自信，编辑美妆，梦幻柔软，巴黎优雅，美妆痴迷，昂贵极简主义，人类温暖。

这个广告应该感觉：柔软、可触、令人上瘾、编辑化、情感奢华。
视觉语言
干净的迪奥美妆美学，轻盈奢侈氛围，最小编辑框架，控制反射，柔和半透明，昂贵简约，奢侈美妆叙事，高端商业美妆摄影。

视觉节奏必须重要：有些画面平静，有些密集，有些亲密，有些产品密集，有些情感人类。

色彩科学
柔和腮红粉，乳白裸粉，真珠白，半透明润泽色调，玫瑰底调，微妙铬银反射。
无过度饱和。无霓虹粉。无暗调分级。无刺眼对比。

色彩必须感觉：昂贵、柔软、编辑化、轻盈、永恒。

照明系统
柔和奢侈日光工作室照明，漫射编辑照明，水润光泽高光，自然反射行为，柔和阴影过渡，奢侈肌肤光泽。
无刺眼阴影。无戏剧性电影黑暗。

相机系统
85mm奢侈美妆镜头，100mm微距美妆镜头，浅景深，编辑美妆框架，奢侈商业现实主义，柔和焦点衰减。

模特系统
女性奢侈美妆模特，柔和女性特征，水润发光肌肤，最小迪奥启发妆容，自然光泽唇部，微妙优雅表情，编辑现实主义。

无夸张时尚姿势。无诡异AI美妆。无过度修饰肌肤。无浓重妆容。

模特应该感觉：昂贵、真实、优雅、向往。

质感现实主义（关键）
超现实湿润光泽，水润唇部反射，可见唇部质感，逼真肌肤毛孔，奢侈玻璃透明度，准确铬反射，真实生活化妆品现实主义。

无塑料肌肤。无蜡质唇部。无假光泽。无AI平滑。

环境系统
最小迪奥美妆工作室，柔和粉白奢侈渐变，轻盈负空间，光泽反射表面，微妙半透明反射，编辑柔软。
无杂乱。无混乱道具。无过度幻想液体。

环境应该感觉：控制、昂贵、最小、编辑。
网格平衡系统（最重要）
网格必须遵循这个确切视觉节奏：
上排：人类 → 微距 → 产品
下排：质感 → 人类 → 人类/唇部细节
这创造：编辑平衡，视觉运动，奢侈节奏，高端广告流动。

title: 夜航日籍空姐温婉写照
promptEn:
Realistic photographic portrait of a fictional adult Japanese woman in her 20s with a sweet-cool aura, soft elegant charm, and a tall slender figure, seated inside a quiet airplane cabin at night.

She is wearing a classic flight attendant-inspired uniform: fitted navy-blue blazer with a subtle gold wing emblem, crisp white button-up blouse, slim navy pencil skirt kept neat and modest, and a silk neck scarf loosely tied. The outfit should look slightly relaxed after a long flight, but tasteful and non-revealing. No underwear visible, no excessive exposure, no transparency, no cleavage emphasis.

Scene: inside an empty business-class airplane cabin at night. Most overhead lights are off. Only soft warm reading lights and faint ambient cabin lighting remain. She is seated in a wide business-class window seat, with the dark night sky and faint distant city lights visible through the window. The cabin feels calm, private, intimate, and cinematic.

Makeup and styling: subtle flushed “slightly tipsy” makeup look, lightweight luminous base with natural skin texture, gentle redness on cheeks and nose bridge, soft warm-brown eyeshadow, naturally defined lashes, slightly moist eyes, glossy rose-red lips with softly blurred edges.

Hair: long black or dark brown hair worn down, slightly tousled from the flight, with a few loose strands naturally falling around her face and shoulders.

Pose: medium close-up to half-body framing. She sits sideways in the wide seat, leaning gently toward the window. One leg is bent comfortably on the seat in a casual but modest way, the other leg angled naturally downward. One hand rests lightly on her lap or thigh, the other hand gently touches her loosened scarf or collar. Relaxed yet elegant posture, quiet vulnerability, understated charm.

Expression: she looks toward the camera with soft, slightly unfocused eyes, as if lost in thought after a long red-eye flight. A faint, ambiguous gentle smile. Tired but graceful, intimate but restrained.

Style: realistic Nikon DSLR photography, natural straight-out-of-camera feel, low contrast, subtle film grain, soft low-light ambiance, shallow depth of field, soft cabin-light bokeh, gentle highlights from the reading light, softly blurred background, slight handheld documentary-style realism.

Mood: quiet, intimate, cinematic, softly alluring, elegant, tasteful, non-explicit.

Aspect ratio: 2:3.

add small white handwriting  text "BubbleBrain" on the bottom right corner
promptCh:
一位虚构的20多岁成年日本女性的现实主义摄影肖像，她散发着甜美酷感的氛围，柔和优雅的魅力，以及高挑纤细的身材，坐在夜晚安静的飞机舱内。

她穿着经典的受空乘启发的制服：合身的海军蓝西装外套，带有微妙的金色翅膀徽章，挺括的白色纽扣衬衫，修身的海军蓝铅笔裙，保持整洁而得体，以及松散系着的丝质围巾。服装在长途飞行后显得略微放松，但仍优雅且不暴露。无内衣可见，无过度暴露，无透明感，无强调乳沟。

场景：夜晚空荡的商务舱飞机舱内。大多数顶灯已关闭，仅剩柔和温暖的阅读灯和微弱的环境舱内照明。她坐在宽敞的商务舱靠窗座位上，透过窗户可见漆黑的夜空和远处微弱的城市灯光。舱内氛围平静、私密、亲近且富有电影感。

妆容与造型：微妙的“略带醉意”妆容，轻薄发光的底妆保留自然肤质，脸颊和鼻梁上柔和的红晕，柔和的暖棕色眼影，自然勾勒的睫毛，略带湿润的双眼，光泽的玫瑰红色嘴唇，边缘柔和模糊。

头发：长长的黑色或深棕色头发披散着，因飞行而略显凌乱，几缕发丝自然垂落在脸庞和肩部。

姿势：中等特写至半身构图。她侧身坐在宽大的座位上，轻轻倚向窗户。一条腿舒适地弯曲置于座位上，以随意却得体的方式，另一条腿自然向下倾斜。一只手轻轻搭在膝上或大腿上，另一只手轻轻触碰松开的围巾或领口。放松却优雅的姿势，安静的脆弱感，低调的魅力。

表情：她以柔和、略微失焦的眼神望向镜头，仿佛在漫长的红眼航班后陷入沉思。淡淡的、模棱两可的温柔微笑。疲惫却优雅，亲密却克制。

风格：现实主义的尼康单反摄影，自然的直出相机感，低对比度，微妙的胶片颗粒，柔和的低光氛围，浅景深，柔和的舱灯光圈，阅读灯带来的柔美高光，背景柔和模糊，略带手持纪录片式的真实感。

氛围：安静、亲密、电影感、柔和诱人、优雅、得体、非露骨。

宽高比：2:3。

title: 双曝风法国旅行高端海报
promptEn:
A high-end cinematic travel poster featuring a professional double exposure composition. Use a provided reference image for the character’s face structure and hairstyle. The subject is a beautiful woman with long curly hair and round gold-rimmed sunglasses, wearing a camera draped over her shoulder, suggesting she is a traveler or photographer.

Her silhouette is blended with a detailed Parisian cityscape inside her lower half, featuring the Eiffel Tower, classic Haussmann-style architecture, and a charming sidewalk café with wicker chairs and a white coffee cup. The lighting is warm golden-hour sunlight, creating a dreamy, nostalgic, and cinematic atmosphere with soft highlights in her hair and across the city scene.

The background is clean and minimal white to emphasize the subject and double exposure effect. At the top, bold elegant serif typography with a metallic gold gradient reads ‘TRAVEL TO FRANCE’, while ‘Paris’ appears in delicate cursive script near the title.

Overall style is a luxury travel magazine cover, ultra-detailed, professional editorial photography aesthetic, balanced composition, soft depth, and premium tourism advertising feel.
promptCh:
一款高端电影风格旅行海报，采用专业双重曝光构图。使用提供的参考图像来确定角色的面部结构和发型。主体是一位美丽的女性，拥有长卷发和圆形金框太阳镜，肩上挂着一台相机，暗示她是一位旅行者或摄影师。

她的轮廓与下半身内部融合了巴黎城市景观的细节，包含埃菲尔铁塔、经典的奥斯曼式建筑，以及一个迷人的路边咖啡馆，配有柳条椅和白色咖啡杯。光线采用温暖的金色时段阳光，营造出梦幻、怀旧且电影般的氛围，她的头发和城市场景中带有柔和的高光。

背景采用干净简约的白色，以突出主体和双重曝光效果。顶部以粗体优雅衬线字体，带有金属金色渐变，写着“TRAVEL TO FRANCE”，而“Paris”则以精致的草书字体出现在标题附近。

整体风格为奢侈旅行杂志封面，超详细、专业编辑摄影美学、平衡构图、柔和景深，以及高端旅游广告感。

title: 极简风女性时尚穿搭手册拼贴
promptEn: Minimalist fashion lookbook collage featuring 8 full-body female models standing against a warm beige studio background. Each model wears elegant, neutral-toned outfits styled in a modern classic aesthetic. Clothing includes silk blouses, cashmere sweaters, linen shirts, knit polos, cardigans, tailored trousers, pleated trousers, wide-leg pants, slim trousers, and an A-line midi skirt. Outerwear includes a houndstooth blazer and a long trench coat. Accessories include structured handbags, tote bags, top-handle bags, belts, wristwatch, and silk scarf. Footwear includes ballet flats, loafers, cap-toe flats, slingback flats, and pumps. Soft lighting, editorial style, clean composition, subtle shadows. Handwritten-style labels pointing to each clothing item. Neutral color palette (cream, beige, black, brown). High detail, fashion magazine aesthetic, 4k resolution.
promptCh: 极简时尚造型手册拼贴画，包含 8 位全身女性模特站在温暖米色工作室背景前。每位模特身着优雅的中性色调服装，以现代经典美学风格搭配。服装包括丝绸衬衫、羊绒毛衣、亚麻衬衫、针织马球衫、开衫、修身长裤、褶皱长裤、宽腿裤、紧身裤，以及一条 A 字中长裙。外套包括千鸟格西装外套和一件长款风衣。配饰包括结构感手袋、托特包、上提手柄包、腰带、腕表和丝巾。鞋履包括芭蕾平底鞋、乐福鞋、圆头平底鞋、露跟平底鞋和高跟鞋。柔和光线，社论风格，干净构图，细微阴影。手写风格标签指向每件服装单品。中性色调（奶油色、米色、黑色、棕色）。高细节，时尚杂志美学，4K 分辨率。

title: 多视角人物参考横版展示页
promptEn: Create a wide, horizontal character reference sheet. The page should include multiple angles of the same character: A front close-up A confident standing front pose (one hand on hip) A back-facing standing pose A squatting pose and hands behind the head (low-angle rear-side view) A kneeling pose on both hands and knees, looking back (low-angle rear-side view) The layout should be customized to fit the character’s personality—visually rich yet clean and easy to read. You may include handwritten-style annotations, small arrows, and a prominent title area styled like a character name header.
promptCh: 创建一张宽幅、横向的角色参考图。页面应包含同一角色的多个角度：正面特写；自信站立正面姿势（一只手叉腰）；背对站立姿势；蹲姿双手抱头（低角度后侧视角）；双手双膝跪姿，回首望去（低角度后侧视角）。布局应根据角色的个性进行定制——视觉丰富但干净易读。您可以加入手写风格的标注、小箭头，以及一个突出标题区域，设计成角色名称标题的样式。
